title: RPF Constable & Sub-Inspector (SI) Master Guide: Physical Standards, CBT Blueprint, Pay & Free Study Kit
summary: Everything you need to crack the Railway Protection Force (RPF) Constable and Sub-Inspector recruitments: 1600m running strategy, CBT mark weightage graphs, physical criteria (PET/PST), 7th CPC salary, and free mock test portals.
author: Sarkari Aavedan Editorial Team
content:
## Introduction & Service Overview

The Railway Protection Force (**RPF**) and Railway Protection Special Force (**RPSF**) under the Ministry of Railways conduct nationwide centralized examinations via the Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) for **Constable (Executive)** and **Sub-Inspector (Executive)** positions. Tasked with protecting millions of daily railway passengers, securing railway assets across 68 divisions, and curbing crimes in station premises, RPF personnel enjoy prestigious Central Police perks, Ministry of Railways free travel passes (Privilege Pass), uniform allowances, and 7th CPC central compensation.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> The **1600 Meters Run for RPF Constable (5 mins 45 secs)** is recognized as one of the toughest physical standards among all Indian uniformed services. **Only 1 chance** is given for the run — candidates who fail the running test are disqualified on the spot regardless of their written CBT score!

## RPF Posts & Pay Scales (7th CPC)

| Post Name | Qualification Requirement | 7th CPC Pay Level | Entry Basic Pay | Approx In-Hand Starting Salary (X-City) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **RPF Sub-Inspector (SI) (Executive)** | Graduate Degree in any stream | **Level-6** | ₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400 | ₹58,000 – ₹65,000 / month (Plus Uniform & Ration Allowance) |
| **RPF Constable (Executive)** | 10th (Matriculation) Passed | **Level-3** | ₹21,700 – ₹69,100 | ₹34,000 – ₹38,000 / month (Plus Free Railway Medical & Travel Pass) |

## Step-by-Step Selection Procedure

1. Complete online registration on the centralized RRB Apply portal (rrbapply.gov.in) with uploaded photo, signature, and community certificates.
2. Appear for the Computer Based Test (CBT) consisting of 120 multiple choice questions for 120 marks in 90 minutes.
3. Candidates qualifying the written cutoff (10 times the vacancies) are called for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) & Physical Measurement Test (PST).
4. Candidates qualifying the running, long jump, and high jump undergo on-site biometric and Document Verification (DV).
5. Attend strict Railway Medical Examination (B-1 medical standard with minimum 6/9, 6/12 distant vision) at designated Railway Hospitals.
6. Report to RPF Training Centers (e.g. JR RPF Academy Lucknow, Moula Ali Hyderabad) for 9-month basic military training.

## Computer Based Test (CBT) Pattern & Weightage Graph

The CBT consists of 120 questions for 120 marks in 90 minutes. There is **1/3rd negative marking** for every incorrect answer.

| Section / Subject | Questions | Marks | Mark Weightage Graph | Core High-Yield Topics |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **General Awareness** | 50 Questions | 50 Marks | [BAR:41.7%:General Awareness] | Everyday General Science (Physics, Chem, Bio), Indian History, Geography, Polity, Current Affairs, Sports |
| **Arithmetic (Mathematics)** | 35 Questions | 35 Marks | [BAR:29.2%:Arithmetic] | Number Systems, Percentages, Ratio & Proportion, Averages, Time & Work, Profit & Loss, Speed Distance Time, Simple/Compound Interest |
| **General Intelligence & Reasoning** | 35 Questions | 35 Marks | [BAR:29.2%:Reasoning] | Analogies, Similarities & Differences, Spatial Visualization, Coding-Decoding, Blood Relations, Syllogisms, Direction Sense |
| **Grand Total** | **120 Questions** | **120 Marks** | **[BAR:100%:Total Composite]** | **Composite Time: 90 Minutes (Sectional Cutoff: None)** |

> [!TIP]  
> **The 50-Mark General Awareness Core**: General Awareness accounts for **41.7% of the total paper**! Aspirants who score 38+ in GA and combine it with 30+ in Reasoning routinely secure cutoffs above 90+ out of 120.

## Physical Measurement Test (PMT) Standards

| Candidate Category | Male Height | Female Height | Male Chest (Unexpanded) | Male Chest (Expanded with min 5 cm) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **UR / EWS / OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)** | 165 cm | 157 cm | 80 cm | 85 cm |
| **SC / ST Candidates** | 160 cm | 152 cm | 76.2 cm | 81.2 cm |
| **Garhwalis, Gorkhas, Marathas, Dogras, Kumaonis** | 163 cm | 155 cm | 80 cm | 85 cm |

## Physical Efficiency Test (PET) — Constable vs. Sub-Inspector

> [!WARNING]  
> For the running events (1600m & 800m), **ONLY ONE CHANCE** is provided. For Long Jump and High Jump events, candidates are given a maximum of **2 chances**.

| Event | RPF Constable (Male) | RPF Constable (Female) | RPF Sub-Inspector (Male) | RPF Sub-Inspector (Female) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **1600 Meters Running** | **5 Mins 45 Secs** (1 Chance) | Not Applicable | **6 Mins 30 Secs** (1 Chance) | Not Applicable |
| **800 Meters Running** | Not Applicable | **3 Mins 40 Secs** (1 Chance) | Not Applicable | **4 Mins 00 Secs** (1 Chance) |
| **Long Jump** | **14 Feet** (2 Chances) | **9 Feet** (2 Chances) | **12 Feet** (2 Chances) | **9 Feet** (2 Chances) |
| **High Jump** | **4 Feet** (2 Chances) | **3 Feet** (2 Chances) | **3 Feet 9 Inches** (2 Chances) | **3 Feet** (2 Chances) |

## 12-Week Physical Conditioning & Running Protocol

- **Weeks 1 to 4 (Base Endurance)**: Run 3 to 4 km at a steady, conversational pace 5 mornings a week to build cardiovascular foundation and lung capacity. Strengthen core muscles with planks and squats.
- **Weeks 5 to 8 (Pacing & Speed Work)**: Shift to 400-meter interval repeats (Aim for 80–85 seconds per 400m lap). Practice jumping techniques onto sandpits twice a week to avoid knee strain.
- **Weeks 9 to 12 (Race Simulation)**: Time your 1600m trial on a standard 400m track every Saturday. Target 5:35 to have a safety buffer for race day adrenaline.
